ACT III OF 2016
ACT III OF 2016
SINDH KATCHI ABADIS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2009
An Act to amend the Sindh Katchi Abadis
Act, 1987
[Gazette of Sindh
Extraordinary, Part IV, 16th February, 2016]
NO.PAS/Legis-B-20/2009,
dated 16.2.2016.---The Sindh
Katchi Abadis (Amendment)
Bill, 2016 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 17th December, 2009. On the legal opinion of the Advocate General, Sindh that since the bill unanimously passed by the Sindh Assembly has not yet been assented by the Government
after lapse of about 6 years as such the same shall be deemed to have been
assented is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient
to amend the Sindh Katchi Abadis Act, 1987, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be
called the Sindh Katchi Abadis (Amendment) Act, 2009.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 19 of Sindh Act No. II of 1987
